_readme: Copy to settings.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Test data only: never a password or any credential. daysFromToday: search close to today (2-3) rather than far out — the Portal snaps to its own nearest available date regardless, so a near search just finds that faster. bundles: leave null to detect from each package's own wording.
savedPassengerSearch: <the mobile number the saved passenger profiles are filed under>
nationality: <the nationality shown on those saved profiles, e.g. Egypt>

nonEgp._note: Group 12 only. A credential that is not in EGP, and its ROE read from the Admin (Master → Miscellaneous → Credential Rate of Exchange, else Rate of Exchange).

admin._note: Admin runs only (run.json environment.admin). Branch → Agency → Agent, exactly as they must be picked in that order on the Admin's Flight Search and every report — each later one only has options once the one before it is picked.

suppliers._note: Optional, per Supplier slug (e.g. "oman-air"): anything here overlays the settings above for that Supplier's runs — its own route (from, to, daysFromToday), multiCity, nonEgp, booking dates…

multiCity._note: Group 10 only. A route with inventory on EVERY leg (3 or more); each leg starts where the previous ended. credentialName is optional — only when the multi-city inventory is on a credential other than the run's.
multiCity.credentialName: <optional: the Portal credential label that sells this route>

multiCityAircraft._note: Group 11 only. A route (2 or more legs) whose flights are on DIFFERENT aircraft types — only the airline decides this, so the human supplies it. Falls back to multiCity.

booking._note: Group 14 only. The same passengers on the same flight twice is refused as a duplicate booking — move this day away from earlier bookings.

clash._note: Group 16 only (the deliberate baggage clash). Same duplicate rule.

bookingMultiCity._note: Group 15 only, optional — falls back to multiCity. Keep its dates clear of earlier bookings.

_verifyExitBooking: Per Supplier. true = the exit-seat groups (05, 06) end with an ASSISTED real booking of the exit seat the seat map let through — --headed, the human presses Book — to track that the booking is refused with a reason. If it is accepted it is a real booking.
